_help: Per-project settings. Key = folder name under projectsRoot (settings.json).
EVERY folder there is listed automatically - this file only adds metadata to them.
A folder with no entry here appears in the group 'New' (top of the list) until you group or hide it.
group       section in the list; 'groups' below sets the order, 'collapsed' the ones folded by default.
mode        WSL mode for Run (a file name in the modes folder: balanced / coding / lightroom). Omit to use whatever mode WSL is in.
pinned      true = Pinned panel + tray 'Run project' menu.     hidden  true = not listed at all.
url         shows an Open button (browser).                  warning  text shown on the card.
compose     false = never run docker compose here. true = allow it even for a worktree / shared compose name.
composeDir  subfolder holding the compose file.              services  only start these compose services.
openVSCode  default true: Run opens VS Code (settings codeFlavor: linux or windows) on the folder.
tools       commands run in the folder (or its 'cwd') after compose up, in order:
{ "name": "Migrate", "command": "docker compose exec -T app alembic upgrade head" }   runs once, must succeed
{ "name": "Dev server", "command": "npm run dev", "cwd": "web", "background": true }   kept running, listed under the project
optional "stop": "..." command, run by the project's Stop.
Background tools stop on Stop / Stop WSL; logs in ~/.cache/devcontrol/run/<project>/.
Git worktrees are detected automatically, grouped under their repo, and never compose'd.
The projects below are examples - rename them to your own folder names, or delete them.
Click Reload in the app after editing.

api-service.warning: Run starts only the local database and cache; the API itself runs in production.

api-service-feature-x.warning: Git worktree of api-service: its compose name is the main checkout's, so compose is disabled here.
